title: 11.14. Saṅkiliṭṭhattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnatiṁsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa …pe… āsevane sattarasa …pe… vipāke ekavīsa …pe… avigate ekūnatiṁsa.
